preamble: In the Zan branch of Kartvelian (Mingrelian and Laz), stem-final *r before the nominative ending *-i became the voiced postalveolar affricate ǯ [d͡ʒ], while Georgian kept r. The correspondence Georgian -ri : Zan -ǯi is regular in inherited nouns such as 'cow' and 'pig'. The change combines palatalization before a front vowel with affrication, and no parallel outside Kartvelian has been found.

examples.note: Laz has the same reflex: puci, puji.
Laz ğeci (Vizha dialect ğeji); the Laz Latin letter c stands for [d͡ʒ].

sources: Klimov, G. A. (1998). Etymological Dictionary of the Kartvelian Languages. Trends in Linguistics. Mouton de Gruyter.
Thorsø, R. (2023). Prehistoric loanwords in Armenian: Hurro-Urartian, Kartvelian, and the unclassified substrate. PhD dissertation, Leiden University. https://hdl.handle.net/1887/3656151
